abstract: Isochromosome(12p), a cytogenetic abnormality characteristic of germ-cell tumors, is exceedingly rare in hematologic disorders. The cytogenetic analysis of a patient diagnosed as refractory anemia with excess of blasts with an associated i(12p), who previously had a teratocarcinoma of the mediastinum, is presented. The cytogenetic analysis was performed at diagnosis of the hematologic malignancy, with all 30 metaphases in the bone marrow culture showing a 47,X, -Y, +8, +i(12)(p10) karyotype. The cytogenetic findings in this patient are compared with those published concerning the association of mediastinal germ-cell tumors and malignant hematologic disorders.
abstract_ja: 等染色体(12p)[i(12p)]は、胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な細胞遺伝学的異常であるが、血液疾患ではきわめてまれである。本研究では、縦隔奇形癌の既往を有し、芽球増加を伴う不応性貧血と診断された患者の、i(12p)を伴う細胞遺伝学的解析を報告する。診断時に行った細胞遺伝学的解析では、骨髄培養の全30中期分裂像が47,X,-Y,+8,+i(12)(p10)の核型を示した。本症例の細胞遺伝学的所見を、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と悪性血液疾患の関連について報告された既報の症例と比較する。
